q: How does a pipe mill in Khalifa Industrial Zone Abu Dhabi report its CBAM figure?
title: Abu Dhabi pipe mill CBAM figure
short: Welded tubes and pierced tubes are CBAM goods. Add the mill's direct emissions from gas in reheating, annealing and coating ovens to the embedded emissions of the coil, plate or billet bought in. Divide by tonnes shipped. Electricity is not counted for steel.
audience: Steel pipe and tube mills in Khalifa Industrial Zone and other UAE industrial zones

ul: Hot rolled coil or plate for welded pipe.
Billet or round bar for pierced tube.
Embedded emissions from each steel supplier, or default values.
Natural gas in reheating and heat treatment furnaces.
Process emissions are small; the steel input dominates.

p: End cuts and rejects carry embedded emissions too, so record input tonnes against shipped tonnes.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
